Грунд сам не может переносить вес, а сид: Grund can't shift his weight himself, and he sits all day. His Trident HD can only recline the backrest — that's how people “relieved” him. We're fitting him a seat with power tilt.
Активная посадка: глубина с зазором 5 см: Active seating: depth with a 5 cm gap to the back of the knee, backrest below the tip of the shoulder blade (31–35 cm), backrest angle 91–97°.
Нужна высокая опора спины до плеч (38–44: Needs high back support up to the shoulders (38–44 cm), a headrest, an open angle of 96–106° and a pressure-relief tilt of at least 45°.
На рисунке: три скелета в разных посадка: In the picture: three skeletons seated differently — active pushing, comfort and support, pressure relief with a 45° tilt.
Поднять подъёмные подножки — ноги вперёд: Raise the elevating legrests — legs out in front
Подъёмные подножки тянут таз назад, на к: Elevating legrests pull the pelvis back onto the sacrum and don't take weight off it.
Шток кастора болтается в стакане — есть: The caster stem wobbles in its housing — there's play. The fork mounting itself is tight.
Признаки замены: стёрта резина, вихляет: Signs it needs replacing: worn rubber, wobbles when spinning, doesn't spin freely.
Колесо цело, ось чистая, крутится свобод: The wheel is intact, the axle is clean and it spins freely — but the whole fork wobbles about.
Несколько спиц (три) на ощупь мягче сосе: A few spokes (three) feel softer than their neighbors — they're loose.
Поставь колесо: нажми кнопку оси, вставь: Refit the wheel: press the axle button, push it fully home, release and tug the wheel — it must not come off.
Недощёлкнутая быстросъёмная ось — колесо: A quick-release axle that hasn't clicked home can let the wheel come off while riding.
Бомм проваливается вниз, до основания си: Bomm sinks down to the seat base, not backwards — and the cushion was going flat when you inspected it.
Накачай подушку через клапан, пока она н: Inflate the cushion through the valve until it starts to arch upward slightly.
Инструкция ROHO: сначала с запасом, точн: ROHO instructions: first with extra air; the fine setting is done with the person sitting on the cushion.
Бомм садится. Спроси разрешения, подведи: Bomm sits down. Ask his permission, slide your hand under his pelvic bones and let air out through the valve until your fingertips can just move.
Ручная проверка ROHO: под самой низкой к: ROHO hand check: 1.5–2.5 cm of air under the lowest pelvic bone (~1 finger). Bottoming out risks pressure sores; an overinflated cushion is like sitting on a rock.
Выключи контроллер, сними заднюю крышку: Turn off the controller, take off the rear cover (two yellow clips, no tools) and press the yellow button on the circuit breaker — the batteries are disconnected from the system.
Автомат стоит на батарейном лотке под за: The circuit breaker sits on the battery tray under the rear cover. Connectors are only touched with the chair powered down.
Осмотри разъём актуатора и вставь его до: Inspect the actuator connector and push it in until the latch clicks.
Опусти рычажок автомата, поставь крышку: Flip the circuit breaker lever down, put the cover back and turn on the controller.
Контроллер изредка пищит, на дисплее — о: The controller beeps now and then; the display shows a joystick error (not a motor one).
На дисплее ошибка джойстика, а не мотора: The display shows a joystick error, not a motor error, and the joystick sticks — that's what makes it veer.
Charge is normal — see the battery inspection.
После просушки включи контроллер и посмо: Once it's dry, switch the controller on and look at the display: what code is it showing? Then switch it off again — the rest is done with the chair off.
Перезагрузка часто «будит» джойстик, а к: A restart often “wakes up” the joystick, and the code tells you where to look: here it's the joystick, not a motor.
Проверь на выключенной коляске, что джой: With the chair off, check that the joystick isn't bent and springs back to center by itself.
Под питанием отклонённый джойстик — это: With the power on, a deflected joystick is a command to drive. So only handle it with the chair off.
Проверь и передёрни разъём кабеля джойст: Check and reseat the joystick cable connector (power off).
Порванный пыльник пускает влагу в электр: A torn boot lets moisture into the electronics — replace it right away, while the chair is off.
У моторов рычаги свободного хода с жёлты: Each motor has a freewheel lever with a yellow tip. They're up now — the motors are in drive mode, so the chair can't be pushed by hand.
Выключи питание кнопкой на пульте — даже: Switch the power off with the button on the joystick — even though it's dark: otherwise the chair wakes up switched on after charging.
После зарядки включи коляску и прокатись: After charging, turn the chair on and take a slow ride: both motors should sound the same.
Iris: 38–51 мм и строго как справа — 45: Iris: 38–51 mm and exactly like the right side — 45 mm
Ниже, чем справа: колёсики должны стоять: Lower than the right side: both wheels must be at the same height (45 mm).
Выше, чем справа (45 мм): коляску снова: Higher than the right side (45 mm): the chair will rock again, and above 51 mm it won't hold.
Rough setting: most of the slack is gone. The check across the full range will show the fine adjustment.
Код 10 вернулся. Выключи коляску и снова: Code 10 is back. Turn the chair off and remove the battery again. Check: the floor is level, the brake levers are up.
Осмотри контакты разъёма между сиденьем: Inspect the contacts of the connector between the seat and the base and sweep the sand out with a brush.
Убедись кнопкой питания, что пульт выклю: Use the power button to make sure the joystick is switched off: a dark screen proves nothing — the breaker is cutting the power right now.
Когда коляска снова уйдёт на хранение —: When the chair goes back into storage: charge it fully and switch the breaker off; once a month switch it on and top up the batteries.
На включённой коляске случайное касание: With the power on, one accidental nudge of the joystick and it drives off. Along with your fingers in the battery bay.
Сними кожухи: передний — за ручки-защёлк: Remove the covers: the front one by its release handles, the rear one by turning the two yellow clips; open the compartment door
Инструмент не нужен. Болты клемм потом —: No tools needed. Terminal bolts go into the magnetic tray later, not “somewhere on the workbench”.
Закрой дверцу отсека и поставь кожухи на: Close the compartment door and refit the covers
Сверь манометром давление в обеих шинах:: Check both tires with the pressure gauge: the pressures must match
Поставь новые щётки в оба мотора (правые: Fit new brushes in both motors (the right ones too, one at a time), in the same orientation; screw the caps on without force and reconnect the plug
Включи питание и обкатай щётки 20–30 мин: Switch on and run the brushes in for 20–30 min (forward/reverse); then switch off and re-engage the gearboxes
Включи питание и проведи тест тормозов:: Switch on and run the brake test: level ground, low speed, joystick forward until the click; then back, left, right
